description.zh: 资源 ID 列表，即云手机 ID 列表。可包含 1~50 个。
description.en: The list of cloud phone IDs. The list can contain 1 to 50 IDs.
The resource type. The value must be \`ALIYUN::ACP::INSTANCE\`.

description.zh: 标签列表。可包含 1~20 个。
description.en: The list of tags. The list can contain 1 to 20 tags.

description.zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以aliyun和acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot be an empty string. The key cannot start with \`aliyun\` or \`acs:\` and cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.

description.zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持 128 个字符，不能以acs:开头，不能包含http://或者https://。
description.en: The tag value. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can be an empty string. The value cannot start with \`acs:\` and cannot contain \`http\://\` or \`https\://\`.
